# FAQ-007 Engineering FAQ #7

Revision: Rev A

Q: What is the correct mandrel clamp bolt torque for the Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill EQ-P1-L2-RR01?
A: Set the mandrel clamp bolt torque to 395 N·m. Verify with SB-1029 and SOP-P1-L2-05 during setup and after maintenance.

Q: What is the system pressure limit for Machining hydraulic forging press EQ-P1-L3-HP02?
A: The system pressure limit is 295 bar. Do not exceed this value; reference SOP-P2-L3-01 for pressure testing and SB-1029 for safety acceptance criteria.

Q: What lubricant part number is specified for Machining shot blast cabinet EQ-P3-L3-SB01?
A: Use lubricant part number CFW-LUB-709. Record lubricant changes in maintenance logs per SOP-P1-L2-05.

Q: What lubricant part number is specified for Machining heat treat furnace EQ-P2-L3-HT02?
A: Use lubricant part number CFW-LUB-373. Confirm inventory and purchase orders against this part number and SOP-P2-L3-01.

Q: What is the coil cooling water flow minimum for Machining induction billet heater EQ-P1-L3-IH01?
A: Maintain a coil cooling water flow minimum of 79 L/min. Follow flow verification procedures in SOP-P1-L2-05 and report deviations to maintenance per SB-1029.

Related documents: SB-1029, SOP-P1-L2-05, SOP-P2-L3-01

Notes:
- These values are control points for equipment safety and performance. Follow the cited documents for procedures, checklists, and acceptance criteria.
- Log any adjustments or nonconformances in the equipment maintenance record and initiate corrective actions as required by SOP-P2-L3-01.
